result.planSummary: Implemented the verifier follow-up for Story 0: ready derivation rows no longer persist fallback gap markers; production fallback paths write durable log entries; writeLog now uses a separate fail-soft store connection; real-store rollback containment coverage was added; public/shared thread-view and inspect shapes now use derivation vocabulary including persisted thread_view JSON.

changedFiles.reason: Tracked database file paths for isolated log writes, added v7 persisted thread_view JSON key migration, and retained derivation/log schema setup.
Made writeLog fail-soft through a separate database connection instead of the caller transaction.
Stopped persisting gaps on ready derivation completion rows while preserving failed derivation state and reason paths.
Moved fallback recording from ready derivation gaps to durable log events in production turn and chunk derivation paths.
Persisted derivationUsed and derivationCounts in thread_view JSON and renamed degraded receipt vocabulary.
Renamed FormSnapshot/FormLookup/formUsed vocabulary to derivation vocabulary.
Renamed selection inputs, arrangement entries, and source-state counts to derivation vocabulary.
Returned derivationUsed from inspect view reports.
Updated public StoredView and CompactReceipt shapes to derivation vocabulary.
Updated public inspect report shapes to derivation vocabulary.
Added production fallback logging coverage and real-store rollback containment coverage.
Updated fallback assertions to expect clean ready rows and durable log entries.
Updated repair assertions for fallback-composed rows without persisted gaps.
Routed raw test database handles through the normal opener so isolated logging can resolve the file path.
Updated shared fallback-rendering fixture invariants for clean ready derivation rows.
Updated stored arrangement golden keys from formUsed to derivationUsed.
Completed Story 0 derivation vocabulary rename across message derivation surfaces.
Completed Story 0 derivation vocabulary rename across turn derivation surfaces.
Updated affected tests and fixtures for derivation vocabulary and clean fallback-row behavior.

gatesRun.command: cd packages/lhc && pnpm exec vitest run test/logging-surface.test.ts

findingsFixed: S0-F1: ready derivation rows no longer persist fallback/gap markers; production fallback paths record fallback events in the durable log.
S0-F2: writeLog is fail-soft and uses a separate database connection; real-store rollback containment coverage was added.
S0-F3: public/shared thread-view and inspect shapes plus persisted thread_view JSON now use derivation vocabulary.

result.recommendedNextStep: Run verifier artifact generation for Story 0 against the updated implementation.
